sections.heading: Who
paragraphs: SoftSolution, based in Poland, decides how your data is used; contact@profitofexile.top.

sections.heading: What the app reads
paragraphs: One screen capture per key press or button click, for recognition; Client.txt to know which module waits.

sections.heading: What is sent
paragraphs: Device ID for statistics and abuse prevention; lab and boss-loot data for shared features; trade results without seller names for shared prices.
Optional: the alias you enter and the role it unlocks, linked to your device ID; ask by email to remove it. A ban keeps only the device fingerprint.

sections.heading: Where
paragraphs: Our servers are in the EU. The app also contacts GGG (trade) and GitHub (updates) directly from your computer.

sections.heading: How long
paragraphs: Device links: 2 years; device IDs: 2 years after last use, except bans; market data retention policy: 21 days; backups and logs: at most 2 years.

sections.heading: Legal basis
paragraphs: GDPR Art. 6(1)(b): providing the service; Art. 6(1)(f): shared statistics, bug fixes and abuse prevention.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Access, correction, deletion, restriction or objection: contact@profitofexile.top; complaints: Polish data protection authority (Prezes UODO).
